idf_component_register(SRCS "app_main.c"
                       INCLUDE_DIRS "."
                       REQUIRES link_state status_light display_tft monitor_server)

# The emote asset pack is generated by esp_emote_assets' own script from
# assets/240_240/{config,emote,layout}.json -- nothing here is hand-packaged.
# CONFIG_MMAP_FILE_NAME_LENGTH has to match what the runtime was built with.
if(CONFIG_WIFI_LED_TFT_EMOTE_ENABLE)
    set(EMOTE_ASSETS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/anim_icon_assets.bin")
    build_speaker_assets_bin("anim_icon" "240_240" "${EMOTE_ASSETS}"
                             ${CONFIG_MMAP_FILE_NAME_LENGTH}
                             "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets")
    esptool_py_flash_to_partition(flash "anim_icon" "${EMOTE_ASSETS}")
endif()
